name: acceptance
description: Negotiate Gherkin acceptance criteria before any code, open the ticket in your tracker (YouTrack or Azure DevOps) and name the branch after it, then collect every proof — captures, videos, cURL, test runs, artifacts — into the ticket. Rules, proofs and the ticket are published as three artifacts per ticket, linked from a band above the prompt, and any later session recovers them from the branch name.

tracker.title: Ticket tracker
tracker.description: Which project manager holds the tickets.

projects.title: YouTrack projects
projects.description: Comma-separated short names of the YouTrack projects tickets may be created in, the default first (e.g. CORE,GROWTH).

azureProject.title: Azure DevOps project
azureProject.description: The Azure DevOps project that holds the work items.

azureWorkItemType.title: Azure DevOps work item type
azureWorkItemType.description: The type of the work items created (User Story, Product Backlog Item, Issue, Task…).

token.title: Tracker token
token.description: A YouTrack permanent token or an Azure DevOps personal access token (Work Items read & write). Leave empty to use the ACCEPTANCE_TRACKER_TOKEN environment variable.
